title: IBM Sterling B2B Integrator 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1, 6.2.2.0 - 6.2.2.1_1 and IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.1.0…
description: IBM Sterling B2B Integrator versions 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1, 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1, and IBM Sterling File Gateway versions 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1, 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 Standard Edition contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper logging of sensitive credentials.
